flags.held_out_set: R4 release gate: n=1200 Common Voice 17 English clips, one per client_id, speaker-disjoint from R2 train and screen; same list as 0.1.0 (no redraw for a hotfix).
scoring_rules_pinned: Gender accuracy = argmax over the {female, male} logits only; the child logit is ignored for BOTH arms.
Margins are RELATIVE to the incumbent audeering/wav2vec2-large-robust-24-ft-age-gender re-scored on the same frozen clips, first 10 s input as in R2.
Ours = int8 ONNX (shipped artifact); fp32 reported beside it.
Paired bootstrap over clips (clip == speaker), B=2000, seed 20261124. Decision uses the CI BOUND.
flags.r4_release_gate: PASS only if ALL: lower 95% bound of (ours - incumbent) gender accuracy >= -2.0 pp; upper 95% bound of (ours - incumbent) age MAE <= +1.0 yr; int8-vs-fp32 parity |d acc| <= 0.5 pp and |d MAE| <= 0.3 yr on the R4 clips. Else close the line -- no rescue variant, no re-tune-and-rerun.
flags.gate_recipe: score_onnx.py (ours), make_audio_npz.py + the incumbent rescore script (not in this repo; Intel XPU), gate_r4.py -- see r4/README.md
flags.claim_wording: 'level with' only (non-inferiority); report CI bounds; age at decade-bucket resolution; child logit 'not predicted'.

budget_rule.held_out_touch: held-out touch budget <= 3 per question (pre-registration rule 6); the R4 list is not re-drawn for 0.1.1, so touches continue from the 0.1.0 count, logged in the release result
budget_rule.rental: none for the freeze; R4 gate, if run, uses the local Intel XPU GPU

after_freeze: No code, head, ONNX, list, scoring or gate change is allowed after this freeze. Any change means a NEW freeze card and a new held-out draw.
out_of_scope: Any code change after this freeze.
